d: India’s defence exports to Europe have surged since the Ukraine war began. Over four years, European countries have placed orders worth more than $800 million with Indian manufacturers — an increase of more than 1,600% from pre-war levels. Most orders are for ammunition, including artillery shells, mortar rounds, explosives and propellant, with many shipments heading to Eastern and Central Europe. Europe is also increasing defence spending and trying to reduce its dependence on the United States. For India, the opportunity now is to move beyond ammunition sales and build deeper…
